text: Host effort deviation for this whole run: every stage is dispatched as a fresh Claude Code harness subagent, which inherits the driver session's reasoning effort, xhigh. Stages whose packets declare EFFORT high (all author stages) therefore run one level above the declared effort; xhigh review stages run exactly at their declared level. The harness exposes no per-dispatch effort control and no pinned-effort subagent definition is loaded in this session. No stage runs below its declared effort.
